about.en: APM is the token of apM Fashion, a project operated by Finnacle Inc. that applies blockchain and AI to the fashion industry, with products including the apM Members customer rewards service, e-vouchers and on-chain verification. The token is a BEP-20 at 0x72a22fAA6a522C81A8F5d508381e18af3dA0921E on BNB Chain.
